hero.title: Savor Pure Organic Delights at South Ruchis Square
hero.subtitle: Experience 60 years of family tradition with 100% organic, farm-fresh vegetarian cuisine, cultivated directly from our own South Ruchis farm.

about.title: Our Heritage: Cultivating Purity for Over 60 Years
about.paragraph1: South Ruchis Square is the proud continuation of a second-generation family legacy, boasting over 60 years of unparalleled expertise in the hotel industry. Under the visionary leadership of Mr. Pradeep G R, our unwavering commitment to authentic, organic vegetarian dining has flourished across four distinguished locations in Bangalore.
about.paragraph2: At the very heart of our culinary philosophy lies our own 'SOUTH RUCHIS farm,' where we meticulously source 100% chemical-free and pest-free vegetables and staples for every dish. This dedication extends to our range of manufactured organic products, including spices, masalas, and breakfast combos, ensuring a wholesome and authentic dining experience that celebrates health and tradition.
